messages:
ops-bot: Incident created: Argus (dedicated) - intermittent isolation observed after VPC peering resyncs. Auto-CC: #incidents, ops-oncall.

sarah-m: Quick postmortem follow-up thread — capturing remediation owners and timelines. Noticed this is the 3rd similar blip in ~8 weeks.

kevin: Yep. Root cause in initial postmortem was stale route-table entries + bgp hold timer mismatch on their on-prem router.

ana: small correction — isolation often happens when we failover from primary to standby peering; KV cache spike + control-plane retries make it worse.

jordan: Action idea: add a preflight check that validates route propagation + peer health before we fail traffic over. Owner? ETA?

kevin: I can own the preflight check work. Plan: prototype this week, pilot on one tenant next Tue. Target PR by 2026-04-06.

ana: I'll take runbook updates and leadbook the on-prem checklist (what to look for on customer routers, expected TTLs, bgp state). Deliverable: runbook PR by 2026-04-04.

tara: I'll handle the monitoring alerts — add a specific alert for rapid bgp flaps + route-table drift and a dashboard tile for Argus peering health. ETA end of next week (2026-04-08).

sarah-m: Great. Two higher-priority followups: (1) short-term mitigation: automatic rollback to cross-region fallback when peering flaps for >30s; (2) longer-term: tighten TTLs and coordinate with network team on hold timers. Who takes (1)?

kevin: I'll add (1) as part of the preflight work; rollout can be gated behind a feature flag. P0 mitigation should be in staging by Fri.

jordan: I'll own coordination with the network team for timer tuning and get a calendar invite with their infra lead. Tentative sync Thurs AM.

ops-bot: Added tasks to incident tracker: TASK-4312 (preflight check) -> kevin, TASK-4313 (runbook) -> ana, TASK-4314 (alerts/dashboard) -> tara, TASK-4315 (net-team sync) -> jordan.

ana: Also proposing a short test harness for on-prem peering flaps. Simple script to simulate route withdraws and measure failover time. I can sketch this in a gist.

sarah-m: Good — include acceptance criteria: <30s failover to fallback route without client 5xxs for our API. Add regression test to CI for dedicated flows.

kevin: Example command I'm using to validate route tables during tests:
```
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters 'Name=tag:Customer,Values=argus'
```
Will capture before/after.

tara: FYI — I'll add runbook link to the incident doc once ana's PR exists so support can reference during customer calls.

jordan: Noted. Also let's track recurrence rate: I'll pull incidents for last 90 days and post a quick summary tomorrow.

sarah-m: OK owners/dates summarized: kevin (preflight & rollback) PR by 2026-04-06, ana (runbook) PR by 2026-04-04, tara (alerts) by 2026-04-08, jordan (net-team sync + recurrence analysis) by 2026-04-02.

ana: Added — I'll ping product if we need an SLA exception during rollout.

kevin: Quick question: do we want an explicit canary (5% traffic) before full rollout?

sarah-m: Yes — canary + automated rollback. Add canary step to TASK-4312.

tara: I'll set up the canary dashboard widget and a PagerDuty schedule for the rollout window.

jordan: I'll post the recurrence summary tomorrow and flag any other tenants with the same pattern.

sarah-m: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene Fri EOD in this thread with blockers. If anything slips, update the incident tracker. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident updated: status -> 'remediations in progress'.
